# Know what is missing before you submit.

> Check a contractor RFP or bid submission for missing documents, owners, and deadline risks. Free, private, and browser-local.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [This checklist vs. a sticky note](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/contractor-bid-readiness/vs-a-sticky-note-checklist.html)
